newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: TIBS rights issue to raise S$35.9 mln -DBS.
newsitem.headline: TIBS rights issue to raise S$35.9 mln -DBS.

text.p: Transportation company TIBS Holdings Ltd plans a one-for-one renounceable rights issue, the Development Bank of Singapore Ltd (DBS) said on Friday.

DBS, which will underwrite and manage the issue, said in a statement it would involve between 45.5 million and 59.5 million new ordinary shares of Singapore $0.50, and had been given in-principle approval by the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
The rights issue, to be made at S$0.80 per rights share for every one ordinary share of S$0.50, is expected to raise net proceeds of about S$35.9 million.
About S$25 million would be injected into a new joint venture company in China, the creation of which was announced in April.
If the joint venture -- still awaiting shareholder approval and regulatory backing in Singapore and China -- did not not proceed, the funds would be used to repay existing bank borrowings.
The balance of about S$10.9 million would be used to expand TIBS's bus and taxi fleet, DBS said.
The rights issue is subject to shareholder approval.
